summary: bench-heldout.js now copies transcript to bench/heldout/journals/SESSION_ID.jsonl after each run (journalPath in results row). New scripts/bench-mine-journals.js reads results, runs extract-decisions on ON-arm solved journals, merges into CANDIDATES.json; --confirm injects into KB.

subject: Wire bench runner to produce per-trial learning journals
description: Three changes: (1) bench-heldout.js: after each trial slice gate-journal by timestamp window [t0, t0+wallMs], annotate with solved/arm labels, write bench/heldout/journals/<candidate>-<armLabel>-<trial>.json; (2) routes/graph.js: pass session_id through to gate-journal rows; (3) new scripts/bench-learn-gate.js: reads journals, extracts feature vectors + labels, outputs threshold recommendations.

summary: Built scripts/bench-learning-journal.js (reducer) and test/bench-learning-journal.test.js. The reducer reads results-heldout.jsonl, groups by (candidate, trial), prefers gated on-arm when multiple consults exist, parses gate decision from the transcript (journalPath → transcriptPath fallback), and emits paired rows with solved_delta and cost_delta_output (λ not baked in). Unpaired groups emit paired:false+missing field. Idempotent full-rebuild. Against real data: 139 groups → 80 paired, 59 unpaired (most unpaired are extra on-arm consult variants without matching off-arm); 32/32 tests pass. Note: outputTokens=0 in most historical rows (field wasn't captured pre-flywheel) → cost_delta_output=0 for those; will be populated correctly in future runs.
